architecture_scope: Allow one actor-local personal escape child to rearm for a genuinely new personal-threat episode when the shared parasite wave remains provisional and non-authoritative. Preserve one stable destination and bounded native retry inside each episode.
gate_state: the exact-source live observation is closed and DVC-published; Chainwielder and Drudges cleared, Magmaw failed the death-loop watchdog, and one bounded trace-backed lifecycle correction is in progress; no build or live retry is admitted before implementation review

first_broken_edge.cause: The actor-keyed child completed one native escape as safe_clearance, but the shared parent remained one provisional non-authoritative generation for the rest of the fight. Later personal-threat episodes could not rearm the terminal child, after which parasite infection and Infectious Vomit reached the stack.

allowed: detect a genuine actor-local personal-threat rising edge after a terminal child
rearm exactly once for the new personal-threat episode even if the parent generation remains provisional
keep one stable actor candidate and destination inside an episode
preserve typed task-created, awaiting, candidate, native-progress, safe-clearance, infected, and failed lifecycle edges
retain bounded progress and alternate-route failure semantics
forbidden: manual Z offsets or vertical steering
MMAP, floor, endpoint, or path-tolerance changes
route advancement with an incomplete roster

acceptance: a stable personal threat cannot rearm a terminal child every tick
clearance followed by a real no-threat interval and a new personal-threat rising edge rearms exactly one new task generation
the new task can progress while the shared parent generation remains provisional without changing its parent identity
the lifecycle is traceable from task creation through native progress to safe clearance or an explicit terminal
physical clearance or endpoint-distance improvement, not submission, remains semantic progress
stale lifecycle, wrong actor, new wave, death, and missing threat cannot reuse an old task
the bot submits a logical destination and the native executor follows terrain without bot-side vertical steering or Z correction
teleport, tolerance relaxation, route-coordinate change, and fallback-coordinate change remain forbidden
all touched C and C++ files remain below 1000 lines

live_diagnostic.required_observation: For every personal parasite threat, retain actor, wave, task generation, candidate key, fixed expiry, destination, authority state, arbitration result, native receipt, same-floor progress while the native executor follows terrain, semantic clearance or typed terminal, deaths, route progression, DPS/HPS, and cleanup.
live_diagnostic.success_condition: The run records the four exact fixture-expansion boundaries with correlated task/native outcomes and cleanup. Promotion still requires the production-boundary predicates, including zero player infection for parasite-control revision 8.
live_diagnostic.failure_condition: Any dropped actor child, key or deadline churn within one wave, infection before a candidate/native outcome, semantic stall, death loop, or route failure closes the single observation run and remains evidence. It does not certify gameplay success.

next_action: Finish and independently review only the actor-local personal-threat episode rearm correction. Run focused multi-wave and no-churn tests. Do not build or start a server until the reviewed implementation and an updated recurrence admission explicitly authorize one next observation.

admission_conditions: the implementation changes only the actor-local personal-escape lifecycle and focused tests
a same-episode stable threat cannot create generation churn
a new threat rising edge after clearance creates exactly one new task generation under a provisional parent
an independent review confirms no Z, route, MMAP, floor, tolerance, planner, executor, or damage change
a later recurrence decision, not this descriptor, must authorize the next build and live run
